queue.title: Review queue
queue.body: Everything waiting for a professional decision, most urgent first.
queue.disclaimerContext: The figures behind these items were produced by a prototype calculator from published equations. They are an estimate, not a clinical assessment.
queue.mineHint: Unassigned items stay visible to everybody until somebody takes them.
queue.emptyBody: No item matches what you asked for.
queue.noReasons: No flag was recorded against this item.

reasons.energy_floor_applied: The target hit the calculator's minimum-intake guard.
reasons.aggressive_deficit: The largest deficit the calculator will produce, with a weight-loss goal.
reasons.safety_critical_restriction: An allergy or a medical restriction is recorded.
reasons.very_low_body_mass_index: Body-mass index is below the range the equations were fitted on.
reasons.very_high_body_mass_index: Body-mass index is above the range the equations were fitted on.
reasons.high_body_fat_percentage: The body-fat figure supplied is high enough to weaken the equation.
reasons.allergen_exclusion_declared: The client declared an allergen exclusion.
reasons.sodium_ceiling_declared: The client set a sodium ceiling themselves; it has not been confirmed clinically.
reasons.restriction_conflict: Two restrictions cannot both be honoured.
reasons.requires_professional_resolution: The conflict needs a professional to resolve it.
reasons.professional_sign_off: A professional sign-off was asked for.

warnings.allergen_conflict: An entry contains a declared allergen.
warnings.energy_out_of_range: An entry is a large share of the day's energy target on its own.
warnings.macros_out_of_range: An entry pushes a macro target outside its tolerance for the day.
warnings.prohibited_ingredient: An entry contains something the client asked to avoid.
warnings.diet_conflict: An entry conflicts with the client's diet classification.
warnings.over_budget: The week is above the budget ceiling the client set.

review.notFoundBody: This review is not one you can open, or it no longer exists.
review.disclaimerContext: The target below came from a prototype calculator. Your judgement replaces it; it does not confirm it.
review.contextTitle: What you need to know first
review.noTarget: No nutrition target is attached to this review.
review.noPlan: No meal plan is attached to this review.
review.actionsNote: Every decision here is recorded against your registration and is visible to the client.
review.setNote: Leave a note on the plan
review.approveDialogBody: Approval is recorded against your registration and shown to the client.
review.approveConsequenceBody: The client sees the target or the plan marked as professionally approved, and the flags that brought it here are cleared.
review.signatureHint: Your name as it should appear to the client.
review.changesDialogBody: The client is told what to change and the item returns to them.
review.changesNoteHint: Be specific. This is the whole message the client receives.
review.overrideDialogBody: Your figures replace the calculated ones, and the reason is stored with them.
review.overrideEnergyHint: Leave this as it is to keep the calculated figure and record only the reason.
review.overrideReasonHint: Stored with the target and shown wherever the figure appears.
review.noteDialogTitle: Leave a note on the plan
review.noteDialogBody: The client sees this note beside their week. Clearing it removes the note.
review.noteHint: Leave it empty to remove the note.

target.title: Nutrition target
target.macrosCaption: The macronutrient split, with each figure's tolerance band.
target.prototypeTitle: These figures came from a prototype calculator
target.prototypeBody: It implements published equations and says which. It is not a clinical assessment and has not been validated against one.
target.overrideTitle: A professional override is already in force
target.noOverride: No professional override is in force on this target.
target.approved: This target has already been professionally approved.
target.notApproved: This target has not been professionally approved.

restrictions.enforcedBody: Only the practice that set these may lift them. The client cannot change them.

plan.title: Client meal plan
plan.noWarnings: The planner raised no warnings on this week.
plan.notFoundTitle: That plan address is not valid
plan.notFoundBody: A client plan is addressed by client, plan and week. Open one from a review.
plan.emptyBody: The client has no entries in the week you asked for.
plan.disclaimerContext: The planned figures below are what the plan intends, not what the client has eaten.
plan.noCost: No cost estimate is available for this week.
plan.plannedNote: These are planned figures. Nothing here records what the client actually ate.
plan.noteHint: The client sees this beside their week. Leave it empty to remove the note.
